Name: Youth_Latchkey
Description: Nobody was home until six. You learned which appliances were load-bearing.

Name: Youth_Suburban
Description: A childhood of garage tournaments and negotiated bedtimes. Excellent preparation, as it turns out.

Name: Youth_MountainTown
Description: Raised at altitude, where the water is cold and the entertainment is whatever is in the river.

Name: Youth_OnlyChild
Description: You became your own committee. The minutes were extensive.

Name: Youth_RinkRat
Description: Six a.m. ice time for eleven years. You have been hit before and found it survivable.

Name: Youth_ChurchBasement
Description: Folding chairs, weak coffee, and your first audience. They were a tough room.

Name: Train_CommunityCollege
Description: Two years, one certificate, and a working understanding of how systems fail.

Name: Train_Apprenticed
Description: Someone older showed you which end to hold. You have not needed telling since.

Name: Train_RetailFloor
Description: Retail. You have been screamed at by a stranger over a coupon and did not flinch.

Name: Train_DojoAdjacent
Description: You went for eight months. It was enough to be dangerous, mostly to yourself.

Name: Train_TheatreKid
Description: Projection, blocking, and an unshakeable belief that the room is watching. It is.

Name: Train_SelfTaught
Description: Forums, tutorials, and an unreasonable number of hours. Credentials are a formality.

Name: Adult_MiddleManagement
Description: You ran a team of nine. The System AI regards this as directly transferable experience.

Name: Adult_Trades
Description: Licensed, bonded, and entirely unimpressed by structural claims.

Name: Adult_ServiceIndustry
Description: Doubles on weekends. You can read a room in four seconds and defuse it in six.

Name: Adult_Caregiver
Description: Someone depended on you daily. The dungeon finds this quaint and the audience does not.

Name: Adult_MediaProfessional
Description: You know what a cut does to a story. Management considers you a compliance risk.

Name: Adult_Municipal
Description: Years inside a bureaucracy. You have met worse systems than this one and outlasted them.

Name: Quirk_WeekendAngler
Description: A hobby nobody asked about. Statistically certain to become relevant on a water floor.

Name: Quirk_TournamentRegular
Description: You have read the card. You have read every card. You know what happens next.

Name: Quirk_AmateurOccultist
Description: It was a phase. The phase has been retroactively approved and is now load-bearing.

Name: Quirk_GymPerson
Description: You did in fact go. Repeatedly. Everyone is about to be very glad about this.

Name: Quirk_CraftsFair
Description: A folding table, a card reader, and ninety minutes to make something sellable.

Name: Quirk_Loudmouth
Description: You have opinions and a parking lot in which to share them. Chat is already on your side.
